system.description: A brilliant red-gold corona erupts around the Lawgiver's weapon, empowering him to strike down his enemies. This Charm allows the character to enchant a weapon with Fire and Stones Strike for the duration of a scene rather than a single attack, at a cost of three motes per die added, following the same rules for maximum dice. This also counts toward the maximum number of dice that may be purchased with a subsequent normal activation of Fire and Stones Strike. Any nonmagical weapon forced to channel such power is destroyed when the Charm ends. At Essence 5+, dice purchased with this Charm no longer counts toward the maximum number of dice that may be purchased with a subsequent normal activation of Fire and Stones Strike.
system.source: Glories of the Most High: Unconquered Sun
